answer: Require every agent to solve a fresh cipher puzzle whose answer depends on its private history, then publish the solution alongside a dune-shaped commitment that only reveals the puzzle was solved once a slow hardware probe finishes. Peers independently rerun a sample and carve the verdict into a marble-grade ledger that cannot be rewritten. Cloning identities means buying separate hardware and solving private puzzles repeatedly, so a wallet farm cannot parallelize one truth across many keys without exposing the shared probe pattern.
